stops.action: Locate the two lower-leg bones relative to the fixed femur in the flexed right knee.
stops.observation: The large yellow tibia is below the blue femur. The smaller fibula is visible at its side in the straight view. The paired arrows mark the qualitative load directions.

stops.action: Follow the Achilles tendon to its heel attachment in plantarflexion.
stops.observation: The blue band narrows toward the yellow heel in both views. Rotating to the side separates the tendon from the green talus.

stops.action: Trace the illustrated lobar route to the enlarged terminal cluster.
stops.observation: The selected pale-blue branch leaves the dark proximal route, meets the short pink terminal segment and ends at the green cluster in both views. The cluster is enlarged.

stops.action: Identify the left ureter, trigone and common outlet on the isolated entry view.
stops.observation: The purple incoming segment is above the green trigone. The yellow outlet is inferior. An edge seam is visible at this magnification, so the check covers order and orientation.

stops.action: Find the aortic arch and descending segment after the heart mask is hidden.
stops.observation: The yellow arch and its descending limb persist in the two isolated views. Removing the heart mask exposes the purple caval and short teal venous masks. Chamber joins remain outside this check.

stops.action: Locate the stomach and distinguish small bowel from colon in the same-case exteriors.
stops.observation: The isolated view reveals the yellow stomach below the blue esophagus. The cyan loops lie inside the darker colon outline. The source mask has gaps and this view supports external localization.

stops.action: Distinguish the two representative root paths near their shared distal region.
stops.observation: The oblique isolate separates pink and teal paths along their lengths. The straight view superimposes much of their course. The oblique angle is required.

stops.action: Locate the superior and inferior gland pairs against the posterior thyroid in the atlas example.
stops.observation: The assembly supplies neck orientation. In the linked same-source posterior view the four highlighted targets sit against the thyroid, with an upper and lower target on each side.

stops.action: Identify the incoming segment, illustrated passage and outgoing segment in the schematic.
stops.observation: The oblique shows the short yellow incoming segment at the bottom of the teal passage and the purple outgoing region above. In the straight projection a detached feature is visible. The adjacent HRA tissue study has a separate source and scale.

stops.action: Follow the left tube from the uterus and find its fringed end beside the ovary.
stops.observation: The purple uterine body leads to a short cyan isthmus, a pink ampulla and a yellow distal fringe beside the blue ovary. The adjacent source study resolves the gap in a closer view.

stops.action: Trace the nail plate from beneath the fold to the exposed free edge.
stops.observation: In the section, the yellow plate emerges from under the blue fold, runs over the darker bed and projects beyond support at the right. The separate whole-body envelope provides orientation only.
